versions.content: Support for core specific current task parameter Type: draft Description: The ARTI template shall define a parameter that contains the evaluation for the current task that is running on a specific core. Rationale: ARTI needs to know which task is running at a core at a specific time. Dependencies: Support for core specific ARTI additions Use Case: Debuggers and Tracing tools need to know the current task to display and trace the core activity. Supporting Material: -
